kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتمسخر (form IIq)
# نَتَمَسْخَرُ (natamasḵaru) /na.ta.mas.xa.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَمَسْخَرَ (tamasḵara)
# نَتَمَسْخَرَ (natamasḵara) /na.ta.mas.xa.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَمَسْخَرَ (tamasḵara)
# نَتَمَسْخَرْ (natamasḵar) /na.ta.mas.xar/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَمَسْخَرَ (tamasḵara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
